name: elvira
label: Elvira
description: Mistress of the Dark. Purple and black, a high-contrast serif, soft edges, and a horror host who is teasing you affectionately the whole way through.

og_image_alt: Night of a Thousand Pixels 2026, styled as a late-night horror host's title card: orchid purple and hot pink on black.

copy.site.title: A Thousand Pixels After Dark
copy.site.tagline: Thirty friends, two picks each, one movie, and me. Unpleasant dreams.
copy.quota.barred: You can rank this year, darling, but you don't get to put anything on the slab.
copy.quota.at_limit: That's all {count} spent for this year.
copy.home.lead: Thirty-odd friends, two picks each, and one deliciously vindictive instant-runoff count that decides what we're all watching. Try to keep up.
copy.home.notice.body: I'm still getting the place ready for this season. Submissions open in early October — the link drops in the group chat, and believe me, you'll know.
copy.home.steps.heading: How one of you gets your way
copy.home.step1.title: Offer something up
copy.home.step1.body: Early October. Sign in and put up to two movies on the slab. A trailer link helps everyone else decide, and helps you look like you had a reason.
copy.home.step2.title: Rank them
copy.home.step2.body: Pick your top three, in order. It's instant-runoff, so a second choice isn't a wasted one — it's the knife you're keeping behind your back.
copy.home.step3.title: Watch
copy.home.step3.body: Movie night. The survivor goes up on the screen, and then into the archive with every poor thing that came before it.
copy.home.archive.heading: Previous victims
copy.home.archive.empty: Nothing to gawk at yet. Old seasons move in as they're dug up, and then they stay.
copy.slate.count.heading: {count} on the slab
copy.slate.hidden.body: This list includes the ones that were quietly withdrawn, marked as such. Nobody else gets to see them. Aren't you special.
copy.slate.empty.heading: Nobody's been brave yet
copy.slate.empty.body: Every year starts exactly like this — an empty slab and thirty people waiting for somebody else to go first. Whoever does sets the tone for the whole night. No pressure, darling.
copy.slate.actions.signin_note: Anyone can look. Only this year's coven gets to touch.
copy.season.state.draft.label: Not yet
copy.season.state.draft.summary: This year hasn't started, darling. The link drops in the group chat the moment it does.
copy.season.state.submitting.label: The slab is open
copy.season.state.submitting.summary: Put something up. Ranking starts the second submissions close, and then it's out of your hands.
copy.season.state.voting.label: Ranking open
copy.season.state.voting.summary: Submissions are closed. Rank your top three — the second choice is the one that does the damage.
copy.season.state.locked.label: Finished
copy.season.state.locked.summary: This one's done and buried in the archive.
copy.outcome.winner.body: {title}. The rest of you will simply have to cope.
copy.outcome.tied.body: The last round came out perfectly level, so nothing won outright. Honestly, that is the most dramatic possible outcome and I am delighted.
copy.movie.trailer.title: Trailer: {title}
copy.submit.heading: Offer something up
copy.submit.lead: A title is all I need. A trailer link and one line about why you picked it is what makes somebody else rank it first — and darling, that is the entire game.
copy.submit.existing.heading: {count} from you so far
copy.submit.errors.heading: {count} to fix before I let this through.
copy.submit.field.title.label: Title
copy.submit.field.title.hint: The name of the picture. It's the one thing I can't guess.
copy.submit.field.year.label: Year
copy.submit.field.year.hint: Optional, four digits. It settles which remake you meant, and there is always a remake.
copy.submit.field.trailer.label: Trailer link
copy.submit.field.trailer.hint: Optional. A YouTube link plays right here on the slab; anything else just becomes a link.
copy.submit.field.description.label: Why this one
copy.submit.field.description.hint: Optional, and the part everyone actually reads. One good sentence beats three dull ones.
copy.submit.blocked.locked.heading: That one's over, darling
copy.submit.blocked.locked.body: {season} is in the archive, and an archived year doesn't budge. Its slate is what it is. Let it rest.
copy.submit.blocked.voting.heading: The slab is closed
copy.submit.blocked.voting.body: Submissions are done for this year — everything that made it is out there being judged. Ranking decides the rest now.
copy.submit.blocked.draft.heading: Not yet, darling
copy.submit.blocked.draft.body_dated: The slab opens on {date}. The link drops in the group chat when it does.
copy.submit.blocked.draft.body_undated: The dates aren't set yet. The link drops in the group chat the moment they are.
copy.submit.blocked.barred.heading: You're here to judge, not to offer
copy.submit.blocked.barred.body: {quota} That's a setting on your name rather than something you used up, so say something in the group chat if it looks wrong to you.
copy.submit.blocked.at_limit.heading: That's both of them, greedy
copy.submit.blocked.at_limit.body_dated: {quota} They're below, and you should be proud of at least one of them. Ranking opens on {date}.
copy.submit.blocked.at_limit.body_undated: {quota} They're below, and you should be proud of at least one of them. Ranking opens once submissions close.
copy.submit.blocked.outsider.heading: This part's for the coven
copy.submit.blocked.outsider.body: The slab is public to look at and not to touch. If you're on this year's list, sign in with the account you gave us. If you're not, ask nicely in the group chat.
copy.submit.blocked.unknown.heading: Not right now, darling
copy.submit.blocked.unknown.body: I'm not taking your submission at the moment, and I'd rather not go into it. The slate is still there to read, and the group chat is the fastest way to find out why.
copy.error.404.heading: There's nothing here
copy.error.404.body: The link might be out of date, or a season that hasn't crawled out yet. Nothing is broken — there is simply nothing at this address, which is somehow worse.
copy.error.500.heading: Well, that was ugly
copy.error.500.body: The server hit an error and gave up on this page entirely. It has been written down. Try again in a minute, and make a scene in the group chat if it keeps happening.
copy.error.405.heading: You can't do that here
copy.error.405.body: The page exists, just not for the kind of request that turned up. Usually that means a stale form, or a submission you reloaded.
